Hey family, welcome to the Cookhouse.

We're Siano's Karibbean CookHouse, Caribbean with a K. Real island flavor, no shortcuts, no long talk.

Pull up for jerk chicken kissed by the grill, oxtail slow-cooked until it's succulent, and curry chicken full of island flavor. Every plate comes with coconut rice and peas, and there's always a vegan option on deck.

We've fed Medford, Salem and North Portland, and we're almost dialed in on a new location. Join the list and you'll hear it first.

Meet Rafijah

Cooking Caribbean for Oregon since 2021

Rafijah Siano is the chef behind the Cookhouse, and he cooks with Caribbean pride. In his words: “Every plate that leaves the Cookhouse tells a story of where we come from and who we are.”

He started in Medford, where the Rogue Valley Times wrote that “no one should pass on the jerk sauce.” In 2021 he took first place at the Backyard Cook-off. Then came Salem, then North Portland.

On being a chef: “This title wasn’t given—it was earned through hard work, sacrifice, long days, late nights, and an unwavering belief in my purpose.”

The mission stays the same: quality, consistency, and great Caribbean food. Caribbean with a K.
